descriptionPlain:
About Finom
 
Finom is a European tech startup headquartered in Amsterdam, and we’re on a journey towards revolutionizing the financial landscape for entrepreneurs worldwide. Our mission is to develop an all-in-one financial B2B solution that integrates banking functions, accounting, financial management, and invoicing into a seamless, mobile-first platform.
 
We recently closed a €115 million Series C equity round (around $133 million), bringing our total funding to approximately $346 million. This significant investment follows a $105 million growth funding round from General Catalyst, a long-term backer since 2021 known for supporting companies like Airbnb, HubSpot, KAYAK, and Stripe.
 
Finom's platform goes beyond traditional banking, offering invoicing and a growing suite of features, including AI-enabled accounting, aiming to simplify financial management for entrepreneurs. We're actively expanding our reach across key EU markets like Germany, France, the Netherlands, Italy, and Spain.
 
At Finom, we’re not just redefining the entrepreneurial experience — we’re empowering our employees to make a real difference. Your work matters, and your impact extends far beyond product metrics. We nurture innovation and an inspiring work environment where bold ideas thrive, prioritizing thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and our business as a whole.
 
Maintaining our start-up spirit, we prioritize thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and, of course, our business.


AI Process Owner — Transaction Monitoring & Customer Lifecycle
Team: AFC Product Operations
Focus: Transaction Monitoring — AI alert resolution
Scope: Dedicated to AI automation of the transaction monitoring programme within 1LoD, with scope to extend across the customer lifecycle over time
At Finom, AI is not just a buzzword. It runs through every element of how we work, and we are implementing it in production, in real processes, with real decisions behind it, with operational teams in the leading role to build AI operational processes.
About the role
This position sits in our Customer Lifecycle team — the team that monitors the customer from the moment their account is opened at Finom and throughout their entire life with us. That remit covers transaction monitoring, regular (periodic) reviews and general ongoing customer monitoring.
This role is specifically focused on transaction monitoring alert resolution, with the possibility to extend scope across the wider customer lifecycle in future, depending on your experience and your success in the position.
The role is a full dedication to projects that automate elements of our transaction monitoring programme using AI. Concretely, that means three things:
Designing and implementing AI-driven alert resolution — moving work that analysts do manually today into AI-supported and AI-executed flows.
Supporting analysts through the transition from manual investigation to AI output validation and model validation — a genuine change in what the job of an analyst looks like.
Building AI agents that replace manual work end to end, and defining where an agent can act and where a human must.
You will be the person who understands both sides of the equation: what a solid AML framework requires, and what AI can realistically and defensibly do inside that framework. Knowing where the limits are matters as much as knowing what is possible.
Key responsibilities
Own AI implementation for transaction monitoring alert resolution — from identifying the highest-value manual steps, to specifying the solution, to running it in production.
Understand the alert resolution process from pick up to false positive, true positive, or offboarding.
Build AI-driven investigation capability — AI-supported investigation of customers, of suspicious transactions, and of behavioural and network patterns across our customer base.
Build and iterate on AI agents that take over manual analyst work, with clear boundaries, escalation logic and audit trails.
Redesign the alert resolution process around AI: what is automated, what is validated, what stays fully human, and how quality is evidenced.
Define the AI/AML boundary — where AI can be used within a transaction monitoring framework, where it cannot, and how we document and defend that position to 2nd Line risk management, audit and regulators.
Support and upskill analysts through the transition to model and output validation, including guidance, training and new working procedures.
Work hands-on with data — analyse alert and customer data to find inefficiency, false-positive drivers and automation opportunities, and to measure whether changes actually worked.
Partner with technical teams and stakeholders — AI team, Data, Engineering, Product, risk management — translating operational and AML needs into technical requirements, and technical constraints back into operational reality.
Keep the customer in view — every alert, freeze, request for information and delay lands on a real customer. Efficiency gains should improve, not degrade, the customer experience.
Own documentation and process ownership — procedures, decision logic, model rationale and controls kept to audit standard.
Key metrics
Your success will be measured on the efficiency and optimisation of the process, including:
Reduction in manual handling time per alert (cycle time) and in overall alert backlog.
Share of alerts resolved or pre-processed by AI, at maintained or improved quality.
Quality and defensibility of AI-assisted decisions — measured through QA, validation sampling and audit outcomes.
Analyst capacity released
Customer-facing impact: fewer unnecessary touchpoints, faster resolution
About you
3+ years of experience in a fintech, bank, EMI or PSP environment, in transaction monitoring and AML.
Hands-on experience in first line of defence alert resolution — you have worked alerts yourself and know what makes them slow, noisy or hard to close.
Solid understanding of AML frameworks and, critically, how to apply them to resolve alerts in practice rather than in theory.
Genuinely AI-oriented — you already use AI across your own work and have experience implementing AI in projects, not just experimenting with it.
Clear view of the limits of AI within a transaction monitoring framework — what can be automated, what needs human judgement, and what regulators and auditors will accept.
Technically minded with strong data analysis skills. Comfortable working with data tools such as Databricks, Metabase and Power BI; SQL is a real advantage.
Customer-minded — you treat customer impact as a first-order consideration, not a side effect.
Structured, pragmatic and comfortable owning a process end to end in a fast-moving environment.
Professional fluency in English.
Nice to have
Experience building or deploying AI agents or LLM-based workflows in a regulated or operational setting.
Exposure to model validation, model risk management or AI governance
Experience with transaction monitoring vendor systems and rule tuning / threshold optimisation.
Background in periodic reviews, KYC/CDD or ongoing customer due diligence — relevant if the scope extends across the customer lifecycle.
Experience with SAR/STR reporting
Python or similar for data work and prototyping.
What's in it for you
A rare combination: a real AML mandate and a real AI mandate in the same role. You are not advising on automation from the sidelines — you are building it and owning the outcome.
Genuine ownership. This is a process owner role: the decisions on how transaction monitoring works sit with you.
Visible impact from day one, on a programme that directly affects both our regulatory standing and thousands of customers' experience.
Room to grow — scope can expand across the wider customer lifecycle as you deliver.
Direct collaboration with Compliance, Risk, Data, Product and Engineering leadership in a fast-scaling European fintech.
International, remote-friendly team and a culture that rewards initiative over process for its own sake.

AI Process Owner — Transaction Monitoring & Customer Lifecycle
Team: AFC Product Operations
Focus: Transaction Monitoring — AI alert resolution
Scope: Dedicated to AI automation of the transaction monitoring programme within 1LoD, with scope to extend across the customer lifecycle over time
At Finom, AI is not just a buzzword. It runs through every element of how we work, and we are implementing it in production, in real processes, with real decisions behind it, with operational teams in the leading role to build AI operational processes.
About the role
This position sits in our Customer Lifecycle team — the team that monitors the customer from the moment their account is opened at Finom and throughout their entire life with us. That remit covers transaction monitoring, regular (periodic) reviews and general ongoing customer monitoring.
This role is specifically focused on transaction monitoring alert resolution, with the possibility to extend scope across the wider customer lifecycle in future, depending on your experience and your success in the position.
The role is a full dedication to projects that automate elements of our transaction monitoring programme using AI. Concretely, that means three things:
Designing and implementing AI-driven alert resolution — moving work that analysts do manually today into AI-supported and AI-executed flows.
Supporting analysts through the transition from manual investigation to AI output validation and model validation — a genuine change in what the job of an analyst looks like.
Building AI agents that replace manual work end to end, and defining where an agent can act and where a human must.
You will be the person who understands both sides of the equation: what a solid AML framework requires, and what AI can realistically and defensibly do inside that framework. Knowing where the limits are matters as much as knowing what is possible.

Own AI implementation for transaction monitoring alert resolution — from identifying the highest-value manual steps, to specifying the solution, to running it in production.
Understand the alert resolution process from pick up to false positive, true positive, or offboarding.
Build AI-driven investigation capability — AI-supported investigation of customers, of suspicious transactions, and of behavioural and network patterns across our customer base.
Build and iterate on AI agents that take over manual analyst work, with clear boundaries, escalation logic and audit trails.
Redesign the alert resolution process around AI: what is automated, what is validated, what stays fully human, and how quality is evidenced.

Clear view of the limits of AI within a transaction monitoring framework — what can be automated, what needs human judgement, and what regulators and auditors will accept.

Customer-minded — you treat customer impact as a first-order consideration, not a side effect.
Structured, pragmatic and comfortable owning a process end to end in a fast-moving environment.
Professional fluency in English.

Experience building or deploying AI agents or LLM-based workflows in a regulated or operational setting.
Exposure to model validation, model risk management or AI governance
Experience with transaction monitoring vendor systems and rule tuning / threshold optimisation.

Experience with SAR/STR reporting
Python or similar for data work and prototyping.

descriptionPlain:
Art Director, Brand & Marketing Design
About the Role
Finom is building a brand that European entrepreneurs recognise and trust, and right now the visual side of that brand needs an owner.
We are looking for an Art Director to lead our Marketing Design team and take ownership of Finom's visual identity end to end. Not marketing design in isolation: the brand system itself, the guidelines behind it, and how consistently it shows up everywhere Finom appears.
You are joining at a genuine inflection point. Finom is growing fast, helping entrepreneurs around Europe take their businesses to the next level. We have over 200k users with ambition for millions more. Meanwhile, our customers rate us 4.8 on Trustpilot, the only business banking app above 4.7.
Our ambition brings with it a unique set of challenges. Your job will be twofold: raise the creative bar, and build the system that lets a team deliver at volume without the quality dropping.
Your first months will be as much about diagnosis as creation: auditing the existing identity, understanding where the current team and workflows are working or falling short, and putting the foundations in place for what comes next. From there, you'll help determine and lead the next evolution of Finom's visual identity.
This is a hands-on leadership role. You will direct and mentor, and you will also design, setting the visual benchmark yourself, not just reviewing other people's work against it. You will work in close partnership with our VP of Product Design, so that the brand reads as one across marketing, product, and the entire brand experience.
Finom is building an AI-native production pipeline, and we want a creative leader who is already fluent in it. Not someone curious about AI, someone who has shipped with it and can design the workflows, quality gates and brand guardrails that make AI output genuinely good rather than merely fast.
What You Will Be Doing
•  Own Finom's visual identity (the brand system, guidelines, design systems and documentation) and drive consistent adoption across every team and touchpoint, including teams that produce assets outside your own
•  Set and hold the creative bar. Shape visual direction across channels and make consistency and quality non-negotiable
•  Lead and develop the existing Marketing Design team, assess its capabilities and future shape, and determine where additional permanent, freelance or AI-enabled capacity is needed

descriptionPlain:
About Finom
 
Finom is a European tech startup headquartered in Amsterdam, and we’re on a journey towards revolutionizing the financial landscape for entrepreneurs worldwide. Our mission is to develop an all-in-one financial B2B solution that integrates banking functions, accounting, financial management, and invoicing into a seamless, mobile-first platform.
 
We recently closed a €115 million Series C equity round (around $133 million), bringing our total funding to approximately $346 million. This significant investment follows a $105 million growth funding round from General Catalyst, a long-term backer since 2021 known for supporting companies like Airbnb, HubSpot, KAYAK, and Stripe.
 
Finom's platform goes beyond traditional banking, offering invoicing and a growing suite of features, including AI-enabled accounting, aiming to simplify financial management for entrepreneurs. We're actively expanding our reach across key EU markets like Germany, France, the Netherlands, Italy, and Spain.
 
At Finom, we’re not just redefining the entrepreneurial experience — we’re empowering our employees to make a real difference. Your work matters, and your impact extends far beyond product metrics. We nurture innovation and an inspiring work environment where bold ideas thrive, prioritizing thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and our business as a whole.
 
Maintaining our start-up spirit, we prioritize thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and, of course, our business.


We are looking for a Corporate Finance Manager to join Finom's Corporate Finance team.
This is not FP&A. The team is small and senior — business analytics, M&A and investor relations, and financial modelling infrastructure. You will be the fourth member, working directly with the VP of Finance across the topics that sit above the planning cycle.
The most distinctive part of this role is regulatory financial modelling. Finom operates through regulated entities across Europe and is moving up the licensing ladder: banking licence, payment institution and EMI permissions, own funds and capital planning, safeguarding. Each of those steps requires a financial projection that a regulator reads line by line and challenges. Someone has to build it, defend it under questioning, and keep it alive as the business changes underneath it. That is the core of this job.
The rest is broader corporate finance — strategic projects, business cases, board and investor materials, business partnering, and M&A support when a deal is live. The mix moves with company priorities. If you want a narrow lane, this is not it.

lists.content:
Regulatory and licensing models — the primary mandate
  • Financial projections for banking licence and payment institution / EMI applications: P&L, balance sheet, capital and liquidity, built on a basis regulators accept
  • Own funds and regulatory capital planning — requirements, headroom, and behaviour under growth and stress
  • Safeguarding and payment buffer modelling across regulated entities
  • Direct support to legal, compliance and regulatory teams through the application and Q&A cycle — defending assumptions and reworking projections against real deadlines
  • Keeping licence and capital models reconciled to the company financial model and to actuals, rather than drifting into a parallel universe

    • Strategic finance and special projects

  • Business cases and investment cases for new markets, products and initiatives
  • Scenario and sensitivity analysis for the CEO, CFO and Supervisory Board
  • Profitability and unit economics analysis at product, segment and market level
  • Board and investor materials — the numbers and the argument that sits behind them
  • Fundraising support: model preparation, diligence responses, investor questions
  • M&A workstreams when a transaction is live — valuation, structuring analysis, diligence support

    • Business partnering and analysis

  • Partnering selected functions on planning, cost and investment decisions
  • Ad-hoc analysis where the question matters more than the format

• 4+ years in corporate finance, strategic finance, financial modelling, transaction services, or the finance function of a bank or fintech
  • You have built or materially maintained sophisticated financial models for a bank, fintech or financial institution — not only operated someone else's
  • Exposure to regulatory financial models: licence applications, capital planning, ICAAP/ILAAP, or regulatory reporting. This is the differentiator for this role
  • Exceptional Excel / Google Sheets modelling — structure, transparency, error-proofing; you build models other people can pick up
  • Excellent working command of the three financial statements and how they interact
  • Understanding of banking or fintech economics: interchange, net interest income, funding, capital
  • Extreme attention to detail and healthy perfectionism — a wrong number in a regulatory submission is expensive
  • Structured thinking and an ownership mentality; you close the loop without being chased
  • Comfortable working independently with the CFO, CEO and board-level stakeholders
  • Strong written and verbal English

• SQL and familiarity with BI tools (Metabase, Looker, Tableau)
  • Python
  • Hands-on use of AI tools (LLMs, copilots) in modelling, analysis and reporting workflows
  • Treasury, capital management or regulatory reporting background
  • Experience in a firm pursuing or holding a banking licence
  • Big Four, investment banking or consulting foundation followed by an in-house fintech role

lists.content:
Regulatory and licensing models — the primary mandate
  • Financial projections for banking licence and payment institution / EMI applications: P&L, balance sheet, capital and liquidity, built on a basis regulators accept
  • Own funds and regulatory capital planning — requirements, headroom, and behaviour under growth and stress
  • Safeguarding and payment buffer modelling across regulated entities
  • Direct support to legal, compliance and regulatory teams through the application and Q&A cycle — defending assumptions and reworking projections against real deadlines
  • Keeping licence and capital models reconciled to the company financial model and to actuals, rather than drifting into a parallel universe

    • Strategic finance and special projects

  • Business cases and investment cases for new markets, products and initiatives
  • Scenario and sensitivity analysis for the CEO, CFO and Supervisory Board
  • Profitability and unit economics analysis at product, segment and market level
  • Board and investor materials — the numbers and the argument that sits behind them
  • Fundraising support: model preparation, diligence responses, investor questions
  • M&A workstreams when a transaction is live — valuation, structuring analysis, diligence support

    • Business partnering and analysis

  • Partnering selected functions on planning, cost and investment decisions
  • Ad-hoc analysis where the question matters more than the format

• 4+ years in corporate finance, strategic finance, financial modelling, transaction services, or the finance function of a bank or fintech
  • You have built or materially maintained sophisticated financial models for a bank, fintech or financial institution — not only operated someone else's
  • Exposure to regulatory financial models: licence applications, capital planning, ICAAP/ILAAP, or regulatory reporting. This is the differentiator for this role
  • Exceptional Excel / Google Sheets modelling — structure, transparency, error-proofing; you build models other people can pick up
  • Excellent working command of the three financial statements and how they interact
  • Understanding of banking or fintech economics: interchange, net interest income, funding, capital
  • Extreme attention to detail and healthy perfectionism — a wrong number in a regulatory submission is expensive
  • Structured thinking and an ownership mentality; you close the loop without being chased
  • Comfortable working independently with the CFO, CEO and board-level stakeholders
  • Strong written and verbal English

• SQL and familiarity with BI tools (Metabase, Looker, Tableau)
  • Python
  • Hands-on use of AI tools (LLMs, copilots) in modelling, analysis and reporting workflows
  • Treasury, capital management or regulatory reporting background
  • Experience in a firm pursuing or holding a banking licence
  • Big Four, investment banking or consulting foundation followed by an in-house fintech role

descriptionPlain:
About Finom
 
Finom is a European tech startup headquartered in Amsterdam, and we’re on a journey towards revolutionizing the financial landscape for entrepreneurs worldwide. Our mission is to develop an all-in-one financial B2B solution that integrates banking functions, accounting, financial management, and invoicing into a seamless, mobile-first platform.
 
We recently closed a €115 million Series C equity round (around $133 million), bringing our total funding to approximately $346 million. This significant investment follows a $105 million growth funding round from General Catalyst, a long-term backer since 2021 known for supporting companies like Airbnb, HubSpot, KAYAK, and Stripe.
 
Finom's platform goes beyond traditional banking, offering invoicing and a growing suite of features, including AI-enabled accounting, aiming to simplify financial management for entrepreneurs. We're actively expanding our reach across key EU markets like Germany, France, the Netherlands, Italy, and Spain.
 
At Finom, we’re not just redefining the entrepreneurial experience — we’re empowering our employees to make a real difference. Your work matters, and your impact extends far beyond product metrics. We nurture innovation and an inspiring work environment where bold ideas thrive, prioritizing thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and our business as a whole.
 
Maintaining our start-up spirit, we prioritize thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and, of course, our business.


We are looking for a Corporate Finance Manager to join Finom's Corporate Finance team.
This is not FP&A. The team is small and senior — business analytics, M&A and investor relations, and financial modelling infrastructure. You will be the fourth member, working directly with the VP of Finance across the topics that sit above the planning cycle.
The most distinctive part of this role is regulatory financial modelling. Finom operates through regulated entities across Europe and is moving up the licensing ladder: banking licence, payment institution and EMI permissions, own funds and capital planning, safeguarding. Each of those steps requires a financial projection that a regulator reads line by line and challenges. Someone has to build it, defend it under questioning, and keep it alive as the business changes underneath it. That is the core of this job.
The rest is broader corporate finance — strategic projects, business cases, board and investor materials, business partnering, and M&A support when a deal is live. The mix moves with company priorities. If you want a narrow lane, this is not it.

lists.content:
Regulatory and licensing models — the primary mandate
  • Financial projections for banking licence and payment institution / EMI applications: P&L, balance sheet, capital and liquidity, built on a basis regulators accept
  • Own funds and regulatory capital planning — requirements, headroom, and behaviour under growth and stress
  • Safeguarding and payment buffer modelling across regulated entities
  • Direct support to legal, compliance and regulatory teams through the application and Q&A cycle — defending assumptions and reworking projections against real deadlines
  • Keeping licence and capital models reconciled to the company financial model and to actuals, rather than drifting into a parallel universe

    • Strategic finance and special projects

  • Business cases and investment cases for new markets, products and initiatives
  • Scenario and sensitivity analysis for the CEO, CFO and Supervisory Board
  • Profitability and unit economics analysis at product, segment and market level
  • Board and investor materials — the numbers and the argument that sits behind them
  • Fundraising support: model preparation, diligence responses, investor questions
  • M&A workstreams when a transaction is live — valuation, structuring analysis, diligence support

    • Business partnering and analysis

  • Partnering selected functions on planning, cost and investment decisions
  • Ad-hoc analysis where the question matters more than the format

• 4+ years in corporate finance, strategic finance, financial modelling, transaction services, or the finance function of a bank or fintech
  • You have built or materially maintained sophisticated financial models for a bank, fintech or financial institution — not only operated someone else's
  • Exposure to regulatory financial models: licence applications, capital planning, ICAAP/ILAAP, or regulatory reporting. This is the differentiator for this role
  • Exceptional Excel / Google Sheets modelling — structure, transparency, error-proofing; you build models other people can pick up
  • Excellent working command of the three financial statements and how they interact
  • Understanding of banking or fintech economics: interchange, net interest income, funding, capital
  • Extreme attention to detail and healthy perfectionism — a wrong number in a regulatory submission is expensive
  • Structured thinking and an ownership mentality; you close the loop without being chased
  • Comfortable working independently with the CFO, CEO and board-level stakeholders
  • Strong written and verbal English

• SQL and familiarity with BI tools (Metabase, Looker, Tableau)
  • Python
  • Hands-on use of AI tools (LLMs, copilots) in modelling, analysis and reporting workflows
  • Treasury, capital management or regulatory reporting background
  • Experience in a firm pursuing or holding a banking licence
  • Big Four, investment banking or consulting foundation followed by an in-house fintech role

We recently closed a €115 million Series C equity round (around $133 million), bringing our total funding to approximately $346 million. Maintaining our start-up spirit, we prioritize thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and, of course, our business.


We’re looking for a Credit Risk Manager  to build and lead the credit risk framework for our SME Credit Cards/Overdraft , e.g. “Boost“ and “Cushion” products.

Oversee, build, improve Finom’s Credit Risk engine so it could be proudly recognised as best in class (framework, guidance, analytics and technical setup)
Own and develop the end-to-end credit risk framework for credit cards, including eligibility, underwriting, scoring models, limit setting, risk appetite, monitoring, and reporting

Architect the data strategy: Transactional data, multi-country bureau landscape, behavioural data , accounting software, government registry data and first party transactional signals on Finom’s accounts. Design, build and calibrate the early warning indicator / credit monitoring system : transaction velocity, balance deteriorating, payment pattern changes, supplier/customer/revenue concentration shift, signals from the external data sources

AI-native mindset — comfortable leveraging AI tools and agents to enhance productivity and decision-making

Understanding of EMI / PS4 regulation and related reporting requirements
Familiarity with European regulatory frameworks (DNB, ECB/EBA, Basel)

Make a genuine impact on the product
 
Join our upward trajectory, and grow with us. We provide the resources and opportunities for continuous personal and professional development, empowering you to make a genuine impact on our evolving product.
 
Work in the EU
 
Embark on this exciting journey with us and enjoy the flexibility of traveling and working remotely or in a hybrid model across Europe.

Unlock your inner entrepreneur and align your aspirations with ours through our Stock Options Program. This exciting opportunity is available to every team member, from junior team members to our founders.

Work & Swim program
 
Immerse yourself in our exclusive Work & Swim Program. Spend one month in a comfortable corporate apartment in enchanting Cyprus. It's the ideal opportunity to strike the perfect work-life balance while enjoying breathtaking Mediterranean views.

  • Build strong, genuine rapport with customers, especially during challenging or sensitive situations

About Finom
 
Finom is a European tech startup headquartered in Amsterdam, and we’re on a journey towards revolutionizing the financial landscape for entrepreneurs worldwide. Our mission is to develop an all-in-one financial B2B solution that integrates banking functions, accounting, financial management, and invoicing into a seamless, mobile-first platform.
 
We recently closed a €115 million Series C equity round (around $133 million), bringing our total funding to approximately $346 million. This significant investment follows a $105 million growth funding round from General Catalyst, a long-term backer since 2021 known for supporting companies like Airbnb, HubSpot, KAYAK, and Stripe.
 
Finom's platform goes beyond traditional banking, offering invoicing and a growing suite of features, including AI-enabled accounting, aiming to simplify financial management for entrepreneurs. We're actively expanding our reach across key EU markets like Germany, France, the Netherlands, Italy, and Spain.
 
At Finom, we’re not just redefining the entrepreneurial experience — we’re empowering our employees to make a real difference. Your work matters, and your impact extends far beyond product metrics. We nurture innovation and an inspiring work environment where bold ideas thrive, prioritizing thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and our business as a whole.
 
Maintaining our start-up spirit, we prioritize thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and, of course, our business.

descriptionBody:
About the Role
 
As a Customer Care Specialist, you will be the voice of Finom, delivering not just excellent service, but a standout, memorable customer experience. Our goal is not simply to resolve issues, but to turn moments of frustration into moments of trust, and customers into passionate advocates for Finom.
 
You will support customers primarily via phone, while also handling chat and email interactions as needed. You will engage with customers who may be experiencing complex or high-impact issues, and your ability to build rapport, demonstrate empathy, and take ownership will be key to your success.

lists.content:
• You're a seasoned technical leader with strong engineering roots and a track record of building teams that ship products that matter. You communicate clearly with everyone – engineers, product managers, executives – and you're genuinely curious about the product, the users, the business, and how your team's work drives real impact.
  • You don't just manage delivery. You challenge problem framing with your PM partner, ensure the team solves the right problems, and think in terms of business outcomes, not just technical outputs. You're comfortable discussing retention and conversion funnels alongside system architecture. You help the team understand ROI and prioritize based on value and effort.
  • You have deep technical expertise and can still step in to unblock when needed. You balance feature delivery with technical debt, keeping scalability in mind while ensuring the team ships at pace. You make technical decisions through explicit trade-offs, not gut feelings, and help everyone understand the "why" behind choices.
  • You take ownership of both outcomes and people. You run meaningful 1:1s, create growth plans, and own hiring and promotions. You build engaged teams through honest feedback and coaching. You invest in making the team more productive – better tools, smarter processes, fewer bottlenecks.
  • You drive predictable delivery by partnering tightly with Product and Design. You communicate proactively about priorities, risks, and constraints. You encourage healthy debate and move toward "disagree and commit" when needed.

• 5+ years of software development building data-intensive production systems
  • Proven track record leading cross-functional engineering teams
  • Deep technical knowledge: hands-on experience with at least one of the common general-purpose languages and platforms (C#/.NET, Java/JVM, JavaScript/Node, Go), distributed architectures, databases, messaging and queueing systems.
  • Experience in product-led organizations, ideally with international scopeStrong business acumen – you connect engineering work to revenue, retention, and trust
  • Comfortable with product metrics (DAU/MAU, retention, conversion funnels)
  • Exceptional communication in English across all audiencesA builder's mentality: you care about shipping great products and growing great teams

• Backend: .NET Core, PostgreSQL, Redis, RabbitMQ, Kafka, Kubernetes

  • You'll lead teams using React, Swift/Kotlin, Python/ML frameworks, and modern QA tools

descriptionPlain:
Head of Editorial
 
About the Role
Finom is looking for a Head of Editorial to own the words across the Finom experience.
We'll be direct with you, because we'd rather you hear it from us than discover it in the first week: our copy isn't good enough yet. It’s inconsistent, it's longer than it needs to be, it doesn't sound enough like us (which we’re still working out), it doesn't convert as well as we’d like, and errors make it through to publication.
That's the job. You'll own the voice, the style guide and the editorial review layer that makes top notch words systematic rather than accidental. You'll lead our copywriting team, develop them, and help them realise their potential. You'll do this by showing as well as telling: you'll show us what amazing looks like. And you'll set Finom's editorial AI strategy, deciding where generation, drafting and checking genuinely help, and where they don't belong at all.
You will own the English (not localisation, but you'll work closely with the people who do, because English is the source language), which means your standard becomes the ceiling for every market we operate in. Tighten the English and every language gets better.
This is a role for an exceptional editor. Not only a writer, though you'll need to be a strong one. The core of this job is taking someone else's draft and making it materially better, quickly, because you've established a strong standard that brings results. If you find that more satisfying than seeing your own byline, you'll enjoy this job a lot.
What You'll Be Doing
•  Owning the words across the Finom experience: the standard, the voice and the final read
•  Building and owning the style guide, and driving its adoption well beyond the Editorial team
•  Establishing the editorial review layer: who reads what before it ships, against what criteria, and how nothing goes out with errors in it
•  Leading and developing the copywriting team, giving direct and useful feedback, and hiring as the function grows
•  Owning Finom's editorial AI strategy: where generation, drafting and checking are used, where they aren't, and what quality gates they have to pass
•  Writing personally on key projects, campaigns and launches
•  Coordinating across lifecycle, web, paid and social so that Finom's language is consistent everywhere a customer meets us
•  Partnering with Product to make sure brand voice holds inside the product, not just in marketing
•  Working closely with localisation partners so English source quality lifts every market
•  Making copy work commercially: tightening, sharpening and testing so that writing converts rather than merely describes
•  Building the intake and prioritisation model that lets a small team serve rising demand without the standard slipping
What Success Looks Like
In your first 30 days: you've read everything, you know where the worst copy is and why, you've properly assessed the team you've inherited, and you understand where demand actually comes from. You have a diagnosis, not yet a plan. By 45 days: a first version of the style guide is in use, an editorial review layer is running, and errors have stopped reaching publication. By 60 days: intake and prioritisation are agreed with the teams generating demand, the voice is documented and being adopted outside Editorial, and your first AI-assisted workflows are live with quality gates that hold. By 6 months: Finom sounds like one company everywhere. Copy is tighter and converting better, with evidence. The writers on your team are visibly better than when you arrived. Editorial runs as a function rather than a queue.
Who You Are
•  An outstanding and fast editor. You improve other people's writing without taking it over. You do it under deadline, without agonising
•  A precise writer. Your English is exceptional. You cut rather than decorate
•  Direct about quality. You can tell someone their draft isn't working, explain exactly why, and leave them wanting to fix it
•  A brilliant documentor. You've created style guides, review processes or editorial standards where none existed
•  Commercially literate. You treat copy as a lever, not only as craft, and you can point to writing that moved a number
•  Genuinely cross-functional. You get good work shipped through other teams' processes, not just your own
•  Comfortable with ambiguity. There's no style guide, no review process and no documented voice yet. You find that energising
Must-Haves
•  Evidence that you can lead the editorial standard, whether through direct people management, mentoring other writers, or operating as a senior individual contributor with strong stakeholder influence. Experience managing and developing writers is highly valued.
•  Experience producing high-volume marketing and conversion copy in a fast-moving tech or digital environment. In-house experience is preferred, but strong agency backgrounds are equally relevant where you’ve worked at pace across multiple channels.
•  English at native level. Exceptional command of written English, since your work sets the quality ceiling for every localised market
•  Demonstrable AI fluency in an editorial context. Not tool familiarity: evidence that you've set policy in practice, defined where AI isn't used, built the checking layer, and held quality as volume rose
•  A track record of building editorial standards, style guides or review processes from scratch
•  Experience developing writers who measurably improved
•  Ability to work across marketing and product surfaces
•  Based in an eligible EU location, the UK or Ireland
We're deliberately open on background. Editorial and journalism, brand and advertising copywriting, and B2B content marketing are all valid routes into this role. We care about the work and the judgement, not the job titles.
Nice-to-Haves
•  Fintech, financial services or another regulated industry where precision genuinely matters
•  Experience owning voice across both marketing and in-product copy
•  Experience running a source-language function feeding multi-market localisation
•  Experience building or managing a freelance writer network
Why Finom
Finom is building the financial platform European entrepreneurs actually want to use, in a category where almost every brand looks and sounds the same. Our customers rate us 4.8 on Trustpilot, higher than any other B2B banking player in Europe, so the product is genuinely good; the job in Brand is to make sure the way Finom reads and sounds matches it. That means an editorial function you get to build rather than inherit, an editorial AI strategy designed from a clean sheet at a moment when very few companies have worked this out properly, and real appetite at senior level for quality as a way to win rather than a cost line. If you've spent time somewhere the writing was tolerated rather than cared about, this will feel different.
Compensation & Benefits
This role sits at Job Level 6, which includes equity options under Finom's Incentive Plan, eligibility for the High Performance Bonus Plan, and a salary positioned within Finom's range for your location, level and job family, benchmarked to the 50th–75th market percentile.
Our Process
A 30-minute screen, a conversation with the VP of Brand, a three-hour editorial task with a follow-up discussion, a short cross-functional panel, a conversation with the writers you'd be leading, and a final interview with our CMO. We aim to move quickly and we'll tell you where you stand at every stage.

By 6 months: Finom sounds like one company everywhere. Copy is tighter and converting better, with evidence. The writers on your team are visibly better than when you arrived. Editorial runs as a function rather than a queue.

Who You Are

•  An outstanding and fast editor. You improve other people's writing without taking it over. You do it under deadline, without agonising

•  A precise writer. Your English is exceptional. You cut rather than decorate

•  Direct about quality. You can tell someone their draft isn't working, explain exactly why, and leave them wanting to fix it

•  A brilliant documentor. You've created style guides, review processes or editorial standards where none existed

•  Commercially literate. You treat copy as a lever, not only as craft, and you can point to writing that moved a number

•  Genuinely cross-functional. You get good work shipped through other teams' processes, not just your own

•  Comfortable with ambiguity. There's no style guide, no review process and no documented voice yet. You find that energising

Must-Haves

•  Evidence that you can lead the editorial standard, whether through direct people management, mentoring other writers, or operating as a senior individual contributor with strong stakeholder influence. Experience managing and developing writers is highly valued.

•  Experience producing high-volume marketing and conversion copy in a fast-moving tech or digital environment. In-house experience is preferred, but strong agency backgrounds are equally relevant where you’ve worked at pace across multiple channels.

•  English at native level. Exceptional command of written English, since your work sets the quality ceiling for every localised market

•  Demonstrable AI fluency in an editorial context. Not tool familiarity: evidence that you've set policy in practice, defined where AI isn't used, built the checking layer, and held quality as volume rose

•  A track record of building editorial standards, style guides or review processes from scratch

•  Experience developing writers who measurably improved

•  Ability to work across marketing and product surfaces

•  Based in an eligible EU location, the UK or Ireland

We're deliberately open on background. Editorial and journalism, brand and advertising copywriting, and B2B content marketing are all valid routes into this role. We care about the work and the judgement, not the job titles.

•  Fintech, financial services or another regulated industry where precision genuinely matters

•  Experience owning voice across both marketing and in-product copy

•  Experience running a source-language function feeding multi-market localisation

•  Experience building or managing a freelance writer network

Why Finom

Finom is building the financial platform European entrepreneurs actually want to use, in a category where almost every brand looks and sounds the same. Our customers rate us 4.8 on Trustpilot, higher than any other B2B banking player in Europe, so the product is genuinely good; the job in Brand is to make sure the way Finom reads and sounds matches it. That means an editorial function you get to build rather than inherit, an editorial AI strategy designed from a clean sheet at a moment when very few companies have worked this out properly, and real appetite at senior level for quality as a way to win rather than a cost line. If you've spent time somewhere the writing was tolerated rather than cared about, this will feel different.

Compensation & Benefits

This role sits at Job Level 6, which includes equity options under Finom's Incentive Plan, eligibility for the High Performance Bonus Plan, and a salary positioned within Finom's range for your location, level and job family, benchmarked to the 50th–75th market percentile.

Our Process

A 30-minute screen, a conversation with the VP of Brand, a three-hour editorial task with a follow-up discussion, a short cross-functional panel, a conversation with the writers you'd be leading, and a final interview with our CMO. We aim to move quickly and we'll tell you where you stand at every stage.

descriptionPlain:
About Finom
 
Finom is a European tech startup headquartered in Amsterdam, and we’re on a journey towards revolutionizing the financial landscape for entrepreneurs worldwide. Our mission is to develop an all-in-one financial B2B solution that integrates banking functions, accounting, financial management, and invoicing into a seamless, mobile-first platform.
 
We recently closed a €115 million Series C equity round (around $133 million), bringing our total funding to approximately $346 million. This significant investment follows a $105 million growth funding round from General Catalyst, a long-term backer since 2021 known for supporting companies like Airbnb, HubSpot, KAYAK, and Stripe.
 
Finom's platform goes beyond traditional banking, offering invoicing and a growing suite of features, including AI-enabled accounting, aiming to simplify financial management for entrepreneurs. We're actively expanding our reach across key EU markets like Germany, France, the Netherlands, Italy, and Spain.
 
At Finom, we’re not just redefining the entrepreneurial experience — we’re empowering our employees to make a real difference. Your work matters, and your impact extends far beyond product metrics. We nurture innovation and an inspiring work environment where bold ideas thrive, prioritizing thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and our business as a whole.
 
Maintaining our start-up spirit, we prioritize thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and, of course, our business.


We're looking for an IT Operations Engineer who puts internal users first. You'll be the person Finom employees turn to when something breaks, and you'll make sure they leave every interaction unblocked and well looked after.
You'll join the IT Operations team and work day to day across Windows and macOS devices, identity and access, and the SaaS tools hundreds of Finom employees rely on. The team builds and owns the core platforms; you'll run them, support the people who use them, and spot where things could work better.
About You
You enjoy helping people and it shows. You stay calm under pressure, explain technical issues in plain language, and follow up until the problem is actually solved. You treat every ticket as a colleague who needs help, not a queue item.
You're pragmatic and learn quickly. You don't need to build systems from scratch, but you think like a builder: you notice recurring issues, ask why they happen, and suggest a fix, a script, or a better process. You document what you learn so the next person doesn't have to start over.

lists.content:
• Delivering Excellent Internal Support: You'll be the first line of help for Finom employees through Jira Service Management and Slack. You'll triage and resolve requests within SLA, keep users updated, and close tickets with clear, friendly communication. You'll own the employee experience of IT, from a quick password reset to a stressful laptop failure before a big meeting.

  • Troubleshooting Windows and macOS Devices: You'll diagnose and fix hardware, OS, software, and network issues on both platforms, remotely. You'll handle device enrollment and compliance issues in JumpCloud MDM, software installs and updates, and escalate complex cases with a clear write-up of what you've already tried.

  • Supporting Identity, Access, and the Employee Lifecycle: You'll run day-to-day onboarding and offboarding tasks in JumpCloud, Google Workspace, and Torii, handle access requests and SSO issues, and follow our access governance and least-privilege practices.

  • Administering Everyday Platforms: You'll handle user-level administration of tools like Jira, Confluence, Slack, and Notion, and help keep JSM request types, knowledge base articles, and workflows accurate and easy to use.

  • Improving How We Work: You'll spot trends in tickets and flag recurring issues. Where it makes sense, you'll write a knowledge base article, a small script, or propose an automation to the team. You'll support security and compliance efforts (DORA, ISO 27001, SOC 2) by following procedures carefully and keeping good records.

• 2+ years in IT support, service desk, or a similar user-facing technical role

  • Hands-on troubleshooting of both Windows and macOS: hardware, OS, applications, peripherals, and network connectivity

  • A strong customer service track record: patient, empathetic, and clear with non-technical colleagues, including under time pressure

  • Experience with an ITSM or ticketing tool, ideally Jira Service Management, and working to SLAs

  • Working knowledge of Google Workspace or M365 user administration

  • Familiarity with an MDM (JumpCloud MDM, Intune, or Jamf) and an identity provider (JumpCloud, Okta, Entra ID) for everyday tasks like enrollment, password resets, MFA, and SSO issues

  • Good written documentation habits: clear ticket notes and knowledge base articles

  • Fluent English, written and spoken

• Basic scripting (PowerShell, Bash, or Python) and a curiosity for automating repetitive work

  • Confident use of AI tools to speed up troubleshooting and documentation

  • Exposure to security and compliance frameworks (ISO 27001, DORA, SOC 2) or SaaS management tools like Torii

  • Experience with meeting room and AV setups (Google Meet or Zoom Rooms)

  • Experience in a fast-growing or regulated company

About the Role

We're looking for an IT Solutions Engineer who thinks like a systems builder - someone who doesn't just run internal infrastructure, but engineers it away where it shouldn't need a human at some point. This is a build-focused role on our IT Operations team. As we scale past 600 employees, our biggest lever is no longer closing tickets faster - it's removing the work that generates them.

You'll own the automation and integration layer that connects our identity, HR, device, and SaaS-governance systems, so that provisioning, deprovisioning, and access lifecycle events happen reliably and automatically instead of by hand. You'll pair closely with our Solutions Engineer, help set the technical standard for how automations are built and documented, and work cross-functionally with Security, People Ops, and DevOps to design end-to-end solutions rather than point fixes.

A DevOps and API background is exactly what this role is built around: you're comfortable reading API docs, wiring 2-3 systems together, scripting from scratch when a no-code tool won't cut it, and thinking about reliability, edge cases, and security from the first line. Above all, you're curious - about the systems you build, the people who depend on them, and how your engineering decisions impact the business.

lists.content:
• Build the access lifecycle automation layer: Own the design, build, and maintenance of automated provisioning and deprovisioning across our top applications by ticket volume. Implement birthright roles for our highest-volume employee profiles and HiBob-driven trigger events (joiners, movers, leavers) that flow through to downstream systems without manual intervention.
  • Integrate our core systems: Build and maintain the integrations that tie HiBob → JumpCloud → Tequipy (and Google Workspace, Slack, Notion, and the wider SaaS estate) into one coherent, event-driven lifecycle. Use REST APIs, SCIM, and our self-hosted n8n instance to create complex, reliable workflows.

  • Manage identity and access at the backend: Configure and debug SSO/SCIM and SAML flows in JumpCloud as our Identity Provider. Own SSO app integrations end to end, troubleshoot complex provisioning and authentication issues, and keep access governance clean and auditable.

  • Deliver the Security controls programme: Build the automations behind our security and compliance initiatives - local admin removal, least-privilege enforcement - contributing directly to DORA, ISO 27001, and SOC 2 efforts. Security is embedded in every config and every script, not bolted on afterward.

  • Administer and optimize business-critical platforms: Manage the technical backend of Jira Service Management as our ITSM platform - configuring workflows, request types, forms, and automations to streamline internal processes - alongside the wider Atlassian Suite, Slack, and Notion.

  • Own endpoint automation: Build and test JumpCloud MDM device policies, profiles, and scripts for zero-touch deployment across Windows and macOS endpoints (via Apple Business Manager), handling software deployment and OS-level configuration at scale.

  • Drive SaaS and budget optimization: Monitor system logs, performance, and SaaS usage to identify waste and cost-saving opportunities, and implement the technical changes that reclaim them (e.g. license reclamation flows).

  • Document everything you build: Proactively create and maintain technical documentation configs, automation flows, API maps - so that what you build can be run, understood, and extended by the rest of the team. Reliable, documented, alerted workflows are the standard, not the exception.

  • Lead technical projects: Lead smaller technical projects end to end a new SSO app integration, a JSM form build-out, a new integration between systems - owning them from requirement to delivery, and providing technical guidance to the team as you go.

• At least 3 years in IT support, systems administration, or IT/DevOps engineering, with hands-on expertise across Windows and macOS environments.

  • Strong IAM experience: JumpCloud (or a comparable IdP) for SSO, SCIM, and SAML - including configuring integrations and debugging complex provisioning and authentication issues.

  • Strong MDM / UEM experience: endpoint management via JumpCloud MDM (or Intune / Jamf), including profiles and scripts for zero-touch deployment.

  • An automation-first mindset with real scripting skills - PowerShell, Bash, Python, or similar - to build reliable, scalable solutions from scratch, not just wire up templates.

  • API fluency: comfortable reading API documentation and integrating multiple systems (REST APIs, webhooks, SCIM). Experience with n8n or a comparable automation/iPaaS platform.

  • Proficiency administering Google Workspace (or M365) and experience with ITSM tools - ideally Jira Service Management (workflows, request types, automations).

  • Clear, concise communication in English across technical and non-technical audiences - able to explain configs and tradeoffs to Security, People, and Engineering alike.

  • Advanced use of AI tools to accelerate troubleshooting, draft automations, and continuously raise the bar on operational efficiency.

    •

• Familiarity with security frameworks (ISO 27001, DORA, SOC 2) and SaaS governance / management tooling.

  • Experience with HRIS-driven automation (HiBob or similar) and hardware lifecycle tooling (Tequipy or similar).

  • Experience in high-growth, modern infrastructure environments.

  • ITIL 4 Foundation and JumpCloud Core Certification (or willingness to certify).

descriptionBodyPlain:
We're looking for an IT Operations Engineer who puts internal users first. You'll be the person Finom employees turn to when something breaks, and you'll make sure they leave every interaction unblocked and well looked after.
You'll join the IT Operations team and work day to day across Windows and macOS devices, identity and access, and the SaaS tools hundreds of Finom employees rely on. The team builds and owns the core platforms; you'll run them, support the people who use them, and spot where things could work better.
About You
You enjoy helping people and it shows. You stay calm under pressure, explain technical issues in plain language, and follow up until the problem is actually solved. You treat every ticket as a colleague who needs help, not a queue item.
You're pragmatic and learn quickly. You don't need to build systems from scratch, but you think like a builder: you notice recurring issues, ask why they happen, and suggest a fix, a script, or a better process. You document what you learn so the next person doesn't have to start over.

lists.content:
As an Account Manager, you’ll own a book your own portfolio of high value customers (around 1000+ clients) across European markets. This isn’t a passive support role. We want someone who treats their portfolio like a sales territory - building best in class relationships and working with their clients to maximise the value of their Finom account. 

 

This person will prioritise outreach with our data triggers for those customers who need attention.

 

You’ll be measured on what matters: keeping your portfolio in a positive growth state, making customer churn a non starter, and impacting business growth. 

 

This position is critical to Finoms expansion across our Revenue Function and the team is overseen by the Chief Revenue Officer. If you are a hungry, self motivated individual, who is looking for a role they can grow and make their own - this is your seat.

 

Important - hiring is only possible if you are resident in one of these countries: Spain, Poland, Cyprus, Portugal, Hungary, Greece, Serbia, Turkey, Bulgaria & eastern EU.

• Actively managing and engaging the portfolio through a multi channel communication strategy 
  • Building strong relationships with decision-makers and becoming a trusted point of contact for clients.
  • Driving revenue growt, retention and product adoption across Finom’s product suite.
  • Identifying and executing upsell, cross-sell and referral opportunities and avoid churn
  • Using account data, usage signals and portfolio trends to prioritise outreach and identify opportunities or risks
  • Monitoring account health and proactively intervening with at-risk clients to prevent churn.
  • Maintaining accurate Salesforce pipeline, activity and account tracking
  • Using Modjo/AI tools call intelligence to continuously improve performance and share best practices with the team.
  • Supporting clients throughout all lifecycle stages
  • Following relevant AML, transaction-monitoring and internal processes.

• Minimum 1-2 years in a Sales, Account Management, Customer Success position in B2B SaaS or Fintech 
  • Strong communication skills - you know how to open a conversation and create urgency without being pushy and put the customer first 
  • Commercially focused - you think in terms of revenue per account, expansion potential, balancing customer satisfaction with business goals 
  • You use data to make decisions - whether that's spotting a usage drop before it becomes a churn risk or identifying the right moment to have a plan upgrade conversation
  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where the playbook is still being written in places
  • French Native (or almost) and perfect fluency in English 
  • Prior experience with Salesforce or similar tools is a benefit

• Full remote from one of the following countries: 
  • Spain, Poland, Cyprus, Portugal, Hungary, Greece, Serbia, Turkey, Bulgaria & eastern EU
  • Base salary from 24.000 EUR to 36.000 EUR gross per year, based on experience
  • Annual bonus based on targets achieved - up to 12K x year
  • Stock Options
  • Work & Swim from Cyprus

descriptionBody:
We are looking for a Lead AI Engineer to own the technical direction of AI systems across Finom and lead the engineers who build them.

This is a leadership role from day one. You will set the technical and quality bar, lead a team of AI engineers, and stay hands-on in the code. You have done this before — we are not looking for someone stepping into technical leadership for the first time.

You will build AI services for Finom customers, and internal platform solutions that allow other teams to ship AI capabilities of their own. You take architecture responsibility for the services you and your team develop, along with the alignment that comes with it — translating between business intent and technical reality, and challenging product decisions when they are wrong.

This is not a research role. It is a hands-on engineering leadership role focused on production-grade AI capabilities that create clear value for customers and the business.

About the role

Finom builds HR the way we build products — with roadmaps, customers, and measurable outcomes instead of ad hoc admin. We're looking for a People Product Associate to help us apply that thinking across the entire employee lifecycle, from onboarding to offboarding.

This role has two sides that need to live in the same person: someone who can sit with the data, the workflows, and the automation in the background — and someone who can step back and ask "what does this actually feel like for the employee going through it?" You'll gather feedback, run surveys, and use what you learn to shape what gets built next, then go build it yourself.

You'll work closely with the People Product Manager, owning execution on the tools and processes that make our HR experience feel designed rather than accidental.

lists.content:
• Employee lifecycle products — Build and improve the tools and processes behind every stage of the employee journey: onboarding, performance cycles, internal mobility, promotions, engagement surveys, offboarding etc.
  • Employee experience & feedback — Design and run surveys, gather qualitative feedback from employees and managers, and turn what you hear into concrete product improvements.
  • Automation & workflow design — Build internal automations (Google Apps Script, n8n) that connect Slack, Notion, and our HR systems, reducing manual work for HR and managers alike.
  • AI-assisted building — Use AI tools (Claude and similar) to prototype and ship people products faster — from building a working tool from a rough idea to automating a process end to end.
  • Workflow ownership — Work hands-on, keeping data, workflows, and configuration clean and reliable as our processes evolve.
  • Documentation — Keep our Notion space current and genuinely useful for managers and our HR team to self-serve from.

• A product mindset: curious about why a process exists and what it should feel like for the person on the other end of it, not just how to execute it
  • Ability to interpret data: comfortable turning data and feedback into insights, identifying patterns, and using them to inform decisions and improve processes
  • Experience building live products from scratch: hands-on experience taking an idea from concept to a working product, including using AI-assisted development tools to build, test, iterate, and launch
  • Comfortable with Google Apps Script and n8n — you've built and maintained real automations, not just used pre-built ones
  • Comfortable with AI tools like Claude, and genuinely hungry to keep learning new ones — you see AI as a way to build faster, not a novelty
  • Customer centricity mindset: naturally starts from the needs and experience of the end user, actively seeks to understand pain points, and designs solutions that are simple, intuitive, and genuinely useful
  • Employee feedback experience: experience designing and running employee feedback loops, including surveys, pulse checks, structured feedback collection, and translating feedback into concrete improvements

lists.content:
• Own design across the full product lifecycle, from discovery and problem framing to final implementation, QA, and polish.
  • Turn complex fintech and SMB workflows into clear, user-centered experiences, using research, product data, and customer feedback to guide decisions.
  • Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Engineers, Analysts, and fellow Designers to scope work, define outcomes, and ship high-quality solutions.
  • Create essential design artifacts including flows, wireframes, prototypes, high-fidelity mockups, and clear product specs.
  • Contribute to our design system and product quality bar, improving consistency, accessibility, scalability, and craft across the interface.
  • Support high-priority initiatives such as modular pricing, onboarding UX transformation, and AI Copilot features.

• 5+ years in product design, including experience setting direction beyond your own individual work.
  • A portfolio that shows both strong craft and clear, defensible reasoning — not just polished screens.
  • Hands-on experience designing native mobile app products (iOS/Android) 
  • Proven ability to design complex, multi-state platforms (permissions, edge cases, cross-team dependencies).
  • Comfortable challenging and being challenged by Product, Engineering, and Research using data and business context.
  • Fluent professional English.

• Fintech background (industry experience overall isn't required — fintech specifically is a plus).
  • German fluency, or experience designing for German-speaking users.
  • AI tools as a working habit (e.g. rapid prototyping, research synthesis) — not a buzzword.

• Step 1: Async Portfolio Review — We review your portfolio link and one written response to assess craft and design quality before scheduling any calls.

  • Step 2: Hiring Manager Call — A video chat with VP of Design focusing on your ownership, drive, and collaborative style.

  • Step 3: Take-Home Assignment — A practical Finom product case study (3–5 days turnaround) evaluated for strategic thinking, user insights, and design execution.

  • Step 4: Live Presentation & Cross-Functional Interview — A full walkthrough and Q&A with design and product leads.

Finom is looking for a Principal Product Designer to set the design direction for Core Experience — the foundational product surface used across our platform by every customer. This is a senior individual-contributor role: no direct reports, but real scope to define what "good" looks like and prove it in shipped product. You'll work alongside Product Managers, Engineers, Analysts, and Research to turn complex financial workflows into experiences that are simple, accessible, and consistent at scale.

lists.content:
• Own design across the full product lifecycle, from discovery and problem framing to final implementation, QA, and polish.
  • Turn complex fintech and SMB workflows into clear, user-centered experiences, using research, product data, and customer feedback to guide decisions.
  • Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Engineers, Analysts, and fellow Designers to scope work, define outcomes, and ship high-quality solutions.
  • Create essential design artifacts including flows, wireframes, prototypes, high-fidelity mockups, and clear product specs.
  • Contribute to our design system and product quality bar, improving consistency, accessibility, scalability, and craft across the interface.
  • Support high-priority initiatives such as modular pricing, onboarding UX transformation, and AI Copilot features.

• 5+ years of experience in product design, ideally in fintech, SaaS, or complex digital product environments.
  • Formal education in design — such as Product Design, Interaction Design, UX/UI, Visual Communication, HCI, or a related field.
  • A strong portfolio showing user-centered thinking, strong interaction and visual design craft, and polished execution.
  • Experience designing complex platforms with multiple user flows, states, permissions, edge cases, and dependencies
  • Hands-on experience designing native mobile app products (iOS/Android), you should be comfortable with mobile-specific interaction patterns and constraints (touch, limited screen space, performance, offline states)
  • Confidence working in cross-functional squads and explaining design decisions using research, product data, business context, and customer feedback.
  • Strong English communication skills; German language skills or experience designing for German-speaking users are highly valued.
  • AI-native mindset: you actively use AI tools for exploration, synthesis, prototyping, critique, documentation, and faster iteration.

• Step 1: Async Portfolio Review — We review your portfolio link and one written response to assess craft and design quality before scheduling any calls.

  • Step 2: Hiring Manager Call — A video chat with VP of Design focusing on your ownership, drive, and collaborative style.

  • Step 3: Take-Home Assignment — A practical Finom product case study (3–5 days turnaround) evaluated for strategic thinking, user insights, and design execution.

  • Step 4: Live Presentation & Cross-Functional Interview — A full walkthrough and Q&A with design and product leads.

About the Role
Product decisions at Finom are made fast, and we want them made on evidence. You join the Growth & Activation product stream as its analyst, working with PMs and engineers on how new customers discover the product, start using it, and grow with it.
There is no established way of doing product analytics here yet, so you define it: how experiments are designed, how metrics are named and counted, what a readout looks like. You come with your own approach rather than waiting for one to be handed to you.
What you'll do
Work with the product managers and other stakeholders in the stream. Agree priorities with them, and look for the problems worth solving instead of waiting for a request to arrive.
Bring recommendations to the business, including opportunities it does not see on its own.
Define the metrics for the stream: what activation means, what we expect from the funnel, how each number is counted, and how it stays consistent with the way the rest of the company counts the same things.
Design the tests. Hypothesis, primary metric, audience split, duration, and how the result gets read once it lands.
Automate that work, so running a test is routine and not a small project every time.
Build the infrastructure for testing at scale, with external tools or our own, so a testing culture can spread across the product teams.

lists.content:

About the Role
 
As a Customer Care Specialist, you will be the voice of Finom, delivering not just excellent service, but a standout, memorable customer experience. Our goal is not simply to resolve issues, but to turn moments of frustration into moments of trust, and customers into passionate advocates for Finom.
 
You will support customers primarily via phone, while also handling chat and email interactions as needed. You will engage with customers who may be experiencing complex or high-impact issues, and your ability to build rapport, demonstrate empathy, and take ownership will be key to your success.

lists.content:
• Deliver a “wow” customer experience across phone, chat, and email, consistently going above and beyond customer expectations
  • Build strong, genuine rapport with customers, especially during challenging or sensitive situations
  • Actively listen to understand customer needs, concerns, and the root cause of issues
  • Communicate clearly, confidently, and empathetically, explaining situations in a way customers can easily understand
  • Take full ownership of customer issues, acting with urgency to drive resolution as quickly as possible
  • Proactively follow up with customers, keeping commitments and ensuring no issue is left unresolved
  • Turn dissatisfied customers into loyal advocates through outstanding service and personal accountability
  • Collaborate closely with internal teams to escalate, track, and resolve complex issues
  • Accurately document customer interactions and outcomes in internal systems
  • Contribute to continuous improvement by sharing insights and feedback from customer interactions

• Native or fluent speaker in Dutch or German (written and spoken)
  • A minimum of 6 months of customer care service experience — regardless of industry background
  • Strong communication skills with the emotional intelligence to handle high-impact customer situations
  • A natural sense of empathy and a genuine desire to help people
  • Resilience and composure when dealing with complaints or difficult conversations
  • A proactive mindset with strong follow-through — you do what you say you will do
  • Comfort working in a fast-paced, ever-evolving scale-up environment
  • Agile, adaptable, and energized by change
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the confidence to take ownership

• Experience in fintech, banking, payments, or financial services
  • Previous experience in a phone-based customer support role

• 100% remote working.
  • Up to 24.000 EUR Gross base salary x year - depending on experience
  • Up to 15% monthly bonus linked to individual and team performance.
  • Stock Option/Shares program.
  • Usage of the company's flats in Cyprus for our work-and-swim program.
  • Opportunity to develop your skills in a fast paste FinTech environment.
  • B2B Contract

• 7-day operational support model - usually from Monday to Friday
  • Weekend work required once per month / every 6 weeks, with advance scheduling
  • Usually from 9:00 to 18:00 with 1 hour lunch break. At times, shift times between 07:00 and 19:00 CET

Maintaining our start-up spirit, we prioritize thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and, of course, our business.

lists.content:
• Deliver a “wow” customer experience across phone, chat, and email, consistently going above and beyond customer expectations
  • Build strong, genuine rapport with customers, especially during challenging or sensitive situations
  • Actively listen to understand customer needs, concerns, and the root cause of issues
  • Communicate clearly, confidently, and empathetically, explaining situations in a way customers can easily understand
  • Take full ownership of customer issues, acting with urgency to drive resolution as quickly as possible
  • Proactively follow up with customers, keeping commitments and ensuring no issue is left unresolved
  • Turn dissatisfied customers into loyal advocates through outstanding service and personal accountability
  • Collaborate closely with internal teams to escalate, track, and resolve complex issues
  • Accurately document customer interactions and outcomes in internal systems
  • Contribute to continuous improvement by sharing insights and feedback from customer interactions

• Native or fluent speaker in Dutch or German (written and spoken)
  • A minimum of 6 months of customer care service experience — regardless of industry background
  • Strong communication skills with the emotional intelligence to handle high-impact customer situations
  • A natural sense of empathy and a genuine desire to help people
  • Resilience and composure when dealing with complaints or difficult conversations
  • A proactive mindset with strong follow-through — you do what you say you will do
  • Comfort working in a fast-paced, ever-evolving scale-up environment
  • Agile, adaptable, and energized by change
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the confidence to take ownership

• Experience in fintech, banking, payments, or financial services
  • Previous experience in a phone-based customer support role

• 100% remote working.
  • Competitive salary.
  • Up to 15% monthly bonus linked to individual and team performance.
  • Stock Option/Shares program.
  • Usage of the company's flats in Cyprus for our work-and-swim program.
  • Opportunity to develop your skills in a fast paste FinTech environment.
  • Salary from 18.000 EUR to 24.000 EUR based on experience
  • b2b freelancer contract

• 7-day operational support model - usually from Monday to Friday
  • Weekend work required once per month / every 6 weeks, with advance scheduling
  • Usually from 9:00 to 18:00 with 1 hour lunch break. At times, shift times between 07:00 and 19:00 CET
